title: 第十四章 新任务，觉醒异能-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “你说什么？”

    爻雪着实是被这人的话给震惊到了。

    “抱歉，本店不买卖人口。”爻雪说道。

    闻言，女生连忙摆手说道：“不是买卖人口，只是抵押而已，在他们没有凑到足够的积分之前，我给你免费打工，只求你让我们在这里住下。”

    听到她的解释，爻雪还是想要拒绝的，但转念一想，自己打理这么大一家店铺，确实需要一个帮手。

    尤其是这些人看上去可怜兮兮的，眼看着天已经黑了，自己总不能将人给赶出去吧。

    “那行吧，后面是住宿的费用，我给你办一张身份卡，身份卡可在本店消费，消费的金额会在上面显示出来。”爻雪说道。

    “能给我们都办一张身份卡吗？”另外一名有些微胖的男生说道。

    “不行哦。”爻雪拒绝道，“在你们将所有的欠债还清之前，只有她一个人能够办理身份卡，并且在这期间，她不能离开本店，你们可以。”

    这也算是变相的人质了，只要他们还想回来，就只能用这个短发女生的身份卡消费，除非他们将所有的欠款都还清才行。

    闻言，这些人很快就答应了下来，他们也不是傻子，知道现在已经是最好的结果了。

    为了节省积分，他们选择了多人宿舍，女生一间宿舍，男生一间宿舍，刚好能够住下，顺便还买了不少食物，他们之中有人受了伤，他们还买了一些药品和用来包扎的绷带，热水以及一些换洗的衣服。

    床铺什么的宿舍里面都有，倒是不用再买新的了。

    等到众人带着购买的东西朝着楼上走去的时候，只有那名短发女生没有离开，而是留了下来。

    刚刚办理身份卡的时候，爻雪看到了上面的名字，知道这名短发女生名叫李磊。

    能够在刚刚那种情况下，主动站出来将自己当成抵押物，老实说，爻雪还挺佩服这人的勇气的。

    毕竟，如果她是一个坏人的话，很可能会利用这份特权对她做点什么，而她连一点反抗的机会都没有。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

"What did you say?"

Yaoxue was really shocked by what this man said.

"Sorry, our store does not buy or sell people." Yaoxue said.

Hearing this, the girl hurriedly waved her hands and said: "It's not buying and selling people, it's just a mortgage. Before they can collect enough points, I will work for you for free. I just ask you to let us live here."

Hearing her explanation, Yaoxue still wanted to refuse, but then she thought about it. She really needs a helper to manage such a large store.

Especially these people look pitiful. Seeing that it is already dark, I can't drive them out.

"Okay, then there is the cost of accommodation. I will apply for an ID card for you. The ID card can be used for consumption in our store, and the amount of consumption will be displayed on it." Yaoxue said.

“Can you get us all an ID card?” Another slightly fat boy said.

"No." Yaoxue refused, "Before you pay off all the debts, only she can apply for the identity card, and during this period, she cannot leave the store, but you can."

This can be regarded as a hostage in disguise. As long as they want to come back, they can only use the ID card of this short-haired girl to make purchases unless they pay off all their debts.

Hearing this, these people quickly agreed. They were not fools and knew that this was the best result.

In order to save points, they chose a multi-person dormitory, with one dormitory for girls and one dormitory for boys, which was just enough to live in. They also bought a lot of food. Some of them were injured. They also bought some medicines, bandages for dressing, hot water and some changes of clothes.

There are beds and other things in the dormitory, so there is no need to buy new ones.

When everyone walked upstairs with their purchases, only the short-haired girl did not leave, but stayed.

When she just applied for the ID card, Yaoxue saw the name on it and knew that the short-haired girl was named Li Lei.

Being able to take the initiative to stand up and use herself as collateral in the situation just now, to be honest, Yaoxue quite admires this person's courage.

After all, if she was a bad person, he would probably use this privilege to do something to her, and she wouldn't even have a chance to resist.
